name: Perceptual Loss Function for Color Holography
definition: A loss function that transforms RGB intensities into opponent color space and applies low-pass filters to mimic human visual system contrast sensitivity, de-prioritizing high-frequency chrominance and extremely high-frequency luminance errors.
summary: This loss function reduces color deviations in holography by transforming errors into opponent color space and applying low-pass filters that mimic human visual contrast sensitivity.
